statements.status_notes: A timing-based side-channel flaw was found in libgcrypt's RSA implementation that may allow a remote attacker to initiate a Bleichenbacher-style attack, which can lead to the decryption of RSA ciphertexts.
statements.impact_statement: A timing side-channel in libgcrypt's RSA implementation could enable a Bleichenbacher-style decryption attack (the "Marvin Attack"). The container base image currently ships libgcrypt20 1.10.3-2ubuntu0.2, the fixed release (confirmed by pulling the current base image and checking installed package versions directly, since this OS package's version is not pinned by this repository — it tracks whatever the base image resolves to at build time). Independent of the version, checking the Java runtime's own library linkage shows it does not link libgcrypt at all; the package is pulled in only as a dependency of GnuPG/apt/systemd tooling (gpg, gpgv, gpg-agent, dirmngr, libapt-pkg, libsystemd0), none of which Liquibase invokes. Java uses its own JCE crypto providers, not system libgcrypt.

statements.status_notes: Libgcrypt before 1.12.2 sometimes allows a heap-based buffer overflow and denial of service via crafted ECDH ciphertext to gcry_pk_decrypt.
statements.impact_statement: A heap-based buffer overflow in libgcrypt's gcry_pk_decrypt when decrypting crafted ECDH ciphertext. Ubuntu fixed it in libgcrypt20 1.9.4-3ubuntu3.2 (jammy) and 1.10.3-2ubuntu0.1 (noble) in USN-8319-1. The affected builds are jammy libgcrypt20 1.9.4-3ubuntu3 in the Ubuntu 22.04-based 5.0.0 and 5.0.1 tags, and noble libgcrypt20 1.10.3-2build1 in the 5.0.2 to 5.2.0 tags. Tags from 5.2.1 ship a fixed build. libgcrypt20 is pulled in only as a dependency of OS tooling (GnuPG, apt's libapt-pkg and the systemd libraries). The container entrypoint runs only the Liquibase CLI, a user-supplied command, or, when INSTALL_MYSQL is set, the lpm package manager. None of these performs libgcrypt public-key decryption. The Liquibase CLI runs on the JVM, which uses its own Java cryptography providers and does not load libgcrypt. A source review found no references to libgcrypt in Liquibase Secure.
